rationale.consistency: Properly uses modern Go idioms like slices.Clone, slices.Insert, and maps.Clone, matching surrounding code.
rationale.edge_cases: Correctly handles nil options map, nested subroutes, and successive order directives in the same file via existingVal.
rationale.scope: Laser-focused on isolating the 'order' state per-adaptation and preventing global mutation without unrelated refactoring.
rationale.readability: Excellent inline comments explaining the rationale behind map cloning and slice cloning for the order lifecycle.
rationale.robustness: Eliminates data races by cloning the options map before mutation and safely cloning slices to prevent array backing overrides.
rationale.maintainability: Completely decouples global plugin directive order from local per-adaptation overrides, greatly improving maintainability.
